name: document-upload-row
title: Document upload row
description: One requested document, such as a passport or proof of address, with its status, the chosen file and replace and remove, ready to stack.
docs: label names the document and description says what is accepted. status is missing, uploading, uploaded or attention; leave it out and it follows the file. progress, from 0 to 100, fills the bar while uploading, error is the reason shown when it needs attention, and file is what was provided, a File or the { name, size } your server kept; leave file out and the row remembers the one that was chosen. accept and maxSize are checked before onFileChange runs, and a file that fails is turned away with the reason. onFileChange receives the File, or null on Remove and Cancel, and is where you start the upload. required is said in words beside the name and keeps a form from submitting without a file: the row says what is missing and focus goes to its Choose file button. name keeps the real file input in the form for FormData and server actions, and a file can be dropped on the row. The status is a polite live region. labels carries every word.
